description: This file is an HTML source file for the CodeMirror mode that provides syntax highlighting and editing capabilities for Sieve scripts (RFC5228). It includes references to external CSS and JS files, contains embedded JavaScript to initialize CodeMirror, and presents sample Sieve code demonstrating various filtering rules.

methods.name: CodeMirror.fromTextArea
methods.description: Initializes a CodeMirror editor instance on a specified textarea element.
